title: WebhookEvent.Attributes
description: Attributes that describe a webhook event resource.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time that the event was created.

eventType.description: The type of event. See [WebhookEventType](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applebusinessapi/webhookeventtype) for possible values.

isPingEvent.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the event is a ping event.
